text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Distal Intestinal Obstruction (likely Hirschsprung's disease or Distal Intestinal Obstruction Syndrome). Based on the home birth history, bilious vomiting, failure to pass meconium, and X-ray showing dilated loops with no rectal gas, this requires immediate surgical consultation for potential Hirschsprung's disease or meconium ileus. Please take the infant to the operating room immediately.
